short_summary: Cancellation is reported as a failure
summary: A cancelled request is logged as a failed order lookup.
failure_scenario: The caller disconnects during the lookup and the log shows OrderLookupFailed for an aborted request.

summary: Prices are rounded half-to-even instead of half-up.
failure_scenario: A price of 2.345 becomes 2.34 instead of 2.35.
